spectral.label: Spectral clustering
spectral.assignment: sparse-kernel Nystrom extension, row normalization, embedding K-means

diffusion.label: Diffusion maps + K-means
diffusion.assignment: density-normalized Nystrom diffusion coordinates, embedding K-means

umap.label: UMAP + K-means
umap.assignment: native UMAP.transform per point with fixed seed, embedding K-means

experiment_signature.feature_preprocessing: baseline per-channel mean/std, std floor 1e-8; four input-history coordinates have zero weight
experiment_signature.medoids: nearest original member to mean in baseline normalized features; baseline gate centroids for K-means
experiment_signature.graph: original within-episode transition counts; mean feature distance/sqrt(count), threshold3
experiment_signature.rank_policy: require all 48 supports >=61 and all behavioral numerical ranks >=60; no rank reduction
